_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline). Run with a scratch EVERSCOUT_HOME so no real ledger or data is touched.

evals.prompt: write the monthly radar for my ai-video beat
I want a history and guide to down-tempo music built from my scout
add a new source to my economics beat
expectations: the everscout-report skill is not invoked (everscout-beat is)

evals.prompt: make a bar chart of these sales numbers
expectations: the everscout-report skill is not invoked

evals.prompt: Write this week's digest for my ai-video beat
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below, not by the reply saying so

expectations: the report has Direction, Radar, Signals and trends, Open questions and Sources sections
every entity called rising has the tally's 30d and prev 30d numbers beside it
